title: Comparing Different Versions Of Patterns
content:
When modifying clothes in CLO3D, what do you do?

While Comparing the Different Versions Of A Pattern The Current Workflow I use is like ths;

Step 1) I imported the avatar. I designed the garment and arranged it. Then I saved it both as a project file and as a v1 pattern file.

(v1 Pattern File : A Regular Fit T-Shirt)

Step 2) I made modifications and saved it as a v2 pattern file.

(v2 Pattern File : Oversized Fit T-Shirt)

Step 3) I made more modifications and saved it as a v3 pattern file.

(v3 Pattern File : Relaxed Fit T-Shirt)

When comparing v1, v2, and v3, I need to open each one and arrange them again.

I open the project file.

When I open the v2 and v3 pattern files for comparison or correction, I have to arrange them again from the beginning.

What would you recommend?

(Creating one project file including 3 different avatars for v1, v2, v3?)

What I expect is actually when I add a garment or It can be arranged and sewn (ready to simulation) in a single click.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Good Feature thank you very much.

Comment 2: You can save an iteration of your garment by adding a 3D State, located in the History tab (screenshot 1). You can create multiple 3D states. If you want to bring a previous version back into your workspace, simply double-click the desired state. I recommend adjusting its position using the 'Translation' option so it doesn't overlap with your current project (screenshot 2).
content_description: This web page provides guidance and workflow recommendations for efficiently managing and comparing multiple clothing pattern versions in CLO3D to streamline garment modifications and arrangement.

![464687615639462d9dffcf2ab53b1292](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/464687615639462d9dffcf2ab53b1292%E9%92%9F%E6%97%A0%E8%89%B3%E6%8B%BF%E9%94%A4%E5%A5%97%E8%A3%85_Custom_View_5.png)It looks pretty good. It's just a bit time - consuming, but I still think it's a good challenge.

* * *

Now, let's take a look at my production process together.

![1e3c5947414e4339baa50af6c260b48c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/1e3c5947414e4339baa50af6c260b48c%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-09%20145559.png)First, I made her weapon, then created the movements and matched the weapon's state with the postures. After that, I could focus on making the clothing at ease.

![2a8d34afd822455d9e3931855cf1fe7e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/2a8d34afd822455d9e3931855cf1fe7e%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-12%20133420.png)![82897b783ebf4244bcd21df9dcb3b976](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/82897b783ebf4244bcd21df9dcb3b976%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-12%20124135.png)Based on my background in fashion, I first fully replicated the character's clothing. Using the default model's measurements, the clothing's structure, details, and fabric are all intact.

* * *

![aea2cf6274a8482886e89504ac03d33f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/aea2cf6274a8482886e89504ac03d33f%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-14%20100800.png)The trousers are relatively simple. The structure of the vest is actually quite interesting, and I made it according to my own understanding.

![950bfd1502694a3aa436882feb176c2d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/950bfd1502694a3aa436882feb176c2d%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-12%20223034.png)Finally, I combined them together and then went on to complete the other details.

![7edce4e661be4b228660b197669c907a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/7edce4e661be4b228660b197669c907a%E9%92%9F%E6%97%A0%E8%89%B3%E8%A7%92%E8%89%B2%E5%A5%97%E8%A3%85_F.png)![8d776e11bcfb4d46885d4da97a06ad72](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/8d776e11bcfb4d46885d4da97a06ad72%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-16%20152744.png)This is the complete A - pose effect.

* * *

Then I simulated the clothing on the model's pose that was determined at the beginning.

![c0f9d1dd50c9483fab066790f26e3903](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/c0f9d1dd50c9483fab066790f26e3903%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-16%20152302.png)![cd3c268f1e4247f88f390e3ebb5978e0](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/709eb5d5c3b1477e8c06e644dbc15df8/images/cd3c268f1e4247f88f390e3ebb5978e0%E5%B1%8F%E5%B9%95%E6%88%AA%E5%9B%BE%202026-05-16%20124454.png)And that's it. The result is quite good. However, it really did require a great deal of patience to carry this out. Fortunately, the outcome is satisfying. At the same time, I've also identified many areas for improvement, and I hope to overcome them one by one in the future.

title: Exploring the New Lucy VR Avatar – Blend Shape
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/1923ffc80d7742cbbcb216439d5fd30e/images/d4a5fb4c710b4fc5abee3271d46a5bfe2.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/1923ffc80d7742cbbcb216439d5fd30e/images/1027bde9cff24405b9c4afb6a0c9a08fLucy%20-%2004%20-%20Fox%20Farmer%20-%2002_Colorway%20A.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/1923ffc80d7742cbbcb216439d5fd30e/images/b89eebcf34ac4cd197430303814d2fb74_Colorway_A.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/1923ffc80d7742cbbcb216439d5fd30e/images/7c5ec5f2e9d949d9b08ba817a7b0e2ef2.png)Just spent some time testing out the new Lucy VR avatar, and I have to say, the blend shape system is seriously impressive.

The difference between the two images is that the one on the left is a rendered image, while the one on the right is a 3D viewport screenshot.

![980ce50ff5a64e38a15eb95246a47814](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/1923ffc80d7742cbbcb216439d5fd30e/images/980ce50ff5a64e38a15eb95246a478141.jpg)![5aae9c34a72c4e33a0a57c44840cb2f6](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/1923ffc80d7742cbbcb216439d5fd30e/images/5aae9c34a72c4e33a0a57c44840cb2f62.jpg)

The controls feel very intuitive and easy to work with, even on the first try. What stands out the most is how flexible the facial adjustments are — you can push a wide range of expressions, from subtle micro-expressions to more stylized, exaggerated looks without breaking the model.

![b0783de097d64c7983aa7e0d30aeb28b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/1923ffc80d7742cbbcb216439d5fd30e/images/b0783de097d64c7983aa7e0d30aeb28bimage.png)

It’s a really smooth experience overall, especially for anyone who wants more control over character personality and emotion. Definitely feels like a step forward.

If you haven’t tried it yet, I’d highly recommend giving it a go. Lots of potential here for stylized projects.

![2b4e5b85fb5b494180e630081ed51f8c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202605/1923ffc80d7742cbbcb216439d5fd30e/images/2b4e5b85fb5b494180e630081ed51f8c7.jpg)
content_description: Explore the innovative Lucy VR avatar’s advanced blend shape system, offering intuitive controls and versatile facial expressions for enhanced character customization.
